scripts.test:local: bash -c 'set -e; image=blockcluster-smoke; container=blockcluster-smoke-local-$$-$RANDOM; docker build -t "$image" ../..; readiness_log=$(mktemp); cleanup() { docker logs "$container" || true; docker rm -f "$container" || true; rm -f "$readiness_log"; }; trap cleanup EXIT; docker run -d --name "$container" -p 127.0.0.1:8081:8081 "$image"; for attempt in {1..30}; do if curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/version >/dev/null 2>"$readiness_log"; then break; fi; if [ "$attempt" -eq 30 ]; then cat "$readiness_log" >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 2; done; npm test'
